name: Volkswagen
description: Volkswagen is a German car manufacturer founded in 1937 that is known worldwide for reliable and practical mass market vehicles, ranging from compact hatchbacks to electric models.

name: Toyota
description: Toyota is a Japanese car manufacturer regarded as a pioneer in hybrid technology and has been one of the largest and most reliable brands in the world for decades.

name: Ford
description: Ford is an American car manufacturer that popularized the assembly line in the early twentieth century and is still known today for its pickup trucks and sporty models.

name: BMW
description: BMW is a German premium brand known for its sporty driving behavior, rear wheel drive and a strong focus on engineering and luxury finishing.

name: Audi
description: Audi is a German premium brand best known for its quattro all wheel drive system, sharp design language and advanced interior technology.

name: Mercedes-Benz
description: Mercedes Benz is a German luxury brand that is considered one of the oldest car manufacturers in the world and sets the standard in comfort, safety and finishing.

name: Renault
description: Renault is a French car manufacturer with a long history in Formula 1 and a strong lineup of compact and electric city cars.

name: Peugeot
description: Peugeot is a French car brand known for its iconic lion logo, comfortable ride quality and modern interior design.

name: Kia
description: Kia is a South Korean car brand that has grown enormously in recent years thanks to a strong price to quality ratio and an extensive warranty on its models.

name: Hyundai
description: Hyundai is a South Korean car brand that, besides affordable models, has also built a strong reputation in electric vehicles and hydrogen technology.
